verdict.rationale: Checkout.com Issuing documents a mode where authorization requests are sent to the customer for 'complete control', and it supports accept or reject logic and customizable authorization flows. That is first-party real-time decisioning, but the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: documented webhook/endpoint contract and response format, the network time budget or response deadline, a documented timeout fallback (stand-in/default decision) the developer controls, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can approve or decline each authorization in real time — a webhook or auth-stream endpoint my code answers inside the network's time budget, with a documented timeout fallback I control

citations.quote: We can manage decisions for you with card checks and spend controls, or send requests to you for complete control.
